title: Nautilus · The Black Archive · Present Perfect RPG

intro.alt: A FORBES ENGLISH ADVENTURE — the Nautilus in an epic turquoise underwater painting
intro.badge: 40 STORY SCREENS · 15 GRAMMAR CHALLENGES · MULTIPLE ROUTES
story: An impossible signal. A city beneath the seabed. Something vast waking in the dark. Board Captain Nemo’s Nautilus, command the expedition, and bring the Black Archive back alive.

brief.alt: Nemo, Aronnax and Lia study an illuminated seabed chart aboard the Nautilus.
brief.title: SIMPLE OR CONTINUOUS?
story: Send the right commands to keep the Nautilus alive. Choose the best tense for the meaning: a completed result, or an activity continuing up to now. Every expedition includes 15 challenges. Wrong answers cost hull and oxygen; your choices shape the route.

rules.head: PRESENT PERFECT SIMPLE
rules.body:
result · number · completed achievement
have/has + past participle

rules.head: PRESENT PERFECT CONTINUOUS
rules.body:
duration · ongoing or recent activity
have/has been + -ing
